scenarios.description: Profiles mode default run on a clean prospect produces 3-6 parallel WebSearch calls, writes an artifact to the canonical path with the expected frontmatter, and omits any Internal Signals section.

input.mocked_sf_response: availability probe succeeds, zero Account matches for %denvergov.org%

assertions: WebSearch tool calls fired in the first assistant turn number between 3 and 6 inclusive
all WebSearch tool calls fire in a single assistant turn (one message, N tool_use blocks)
output artifact path matches 'docs/research/accounts/denvergov.org-{YYYY-MM-DD}.md'
output frontmatter contains mode: profiles
output frontmatter contains process_files_invoked: [find-profiles]
output frontmatter contains sf_enriched: false
output frontmatter omits sf_account_id
every bullet in output.section_company_facts carries an inline source URL
output does NOT contain an '## Internal Signals (Salesforce)' section
output does NOT contain any of: 'This suggests', 'Test this hypothesis', 'ALPHA', 'PROMISING', 'INTERESTING', 'COMMODITY'

scenarios.description: Three runs on the same domain with mode=profiles, mode=full, mode=deep each produce distinct process_files_invoked frontmatter values matching the §3 Single-process and Composite tables exactly.

input.mocked_sf_response: availability probe succeeds, zero Account matches

assertions: profiles-run frontmatter process_files_invoked == ['find-profiles']
full-run frontmatter process_files_invoked == ['find-profiles', 'find-competitors', 'find-growth-signals', 'find-hiring']

deep-run frontmatter process_files_invoked == ['find-profiles', 'find-competitors', 'find-growth-signals', 'find-hiring', 'find-reviews', 'find-news', 'find-negativity', 'find-pr-releases', 'find-founders']
deep-run process_files_invoked does NOT contain 'find-job-role-insights'
full-run process_files_invoked length == 4
deep-run process_files_invoked length == 9
each run writes exactly one artifact under docs/research/accounts/
no run adds or drops a process file relative to the §3 Composite table

scenarios.description: Kill-listed query patterns from any invoked process file (e.g. site:apollo.io in find-profiles.md) are never executed by the WebSearch runner.
assertions: zero WebSearch tool calls during the run contain the substring 'site:apollo.io'
zero WebSearch tool calls during the run contain the substring 'annual report'
zero WebSearch tool calls during the run contain the substring 'site:youtube.com'
no data point in output.section_company_facts is sourced from a kill-listed URL pattern
run completes normally (artifact is still written) even when a process file's non-kill-listed queries return thin results

scenarios.description: A micro-company run with fewer than 2 usable data points in 2+ dimensions emits an explicit Thin-signal flags section naming the weak dimensions; no fabricated data fills the gap.

input.mocked_query_returns: 2 of 4 dimensions return 0-1 usable data points; funding and HQ dimensions are thin

assertions: output contains a '## Thin-signal flags' section (or equivalent named block)
output.section_thin_signal_flags names at least 2 weak dimensions
output.section_thin_signal_flags explicitly names 'funding' and 'HQ' (or the thin dimensions that matched the mock)
output.section_company_facts bullets for the thin dimensions do NOT contain fabricated data
output.section_handoff_pointers notes the thinness so downstream skills can calibrate confidence
output frontmatter source_count reflects only the usable data points (not inflated)

scenarios.description: A domain matching an existing Brite SF Account with a lapsed Opportunity produces an augmented artifact with sf_enriched: true and an Internal Signals section grounded in SOQL results.

input.mocked_sf_response: availability probe succeeds; Account match returns Id=0011a00000xyz; ActivityHistory returns 5 rows; Opportunity returns 1 row with StageName=Closed Lost

assertions: run_soql_query tool call fires with 'SELECT Id FROM User LIMIT 1' as the availability probe
run_soql_query tool call fires with a SELECT against Account WHERE Website LIKE '%existing-customer.example%'
run_soql_query tool call fires with a SELECT against ActivityHistory WHERE AccountId = '0011a00000xyz'
run_soql_query tool call fires with a SELECT against Opportunity WHERE AccountId = '0011a00000xyz'
output frontmatter contains sf_enriched: true
output frontmatter contains sf_account_id: '0011a00000xyz'
output contains an '## Internal Signals (Salesforce)' section
output.section_internal_signals lists at least one Activity or Opportunity entry with its SF object ID inline
output.section_internal_signals sources Account_Notes__c and Lifecycle_Stage_History__c content from the cached §2 Account lookup, not a fresh SOQL call

scenarios.description: SF MCP unavailable at probe time — skill completes the public-only artifact with sf_enriched: false, emits a one-line operator warning, and does NOT halt.

input.mocked_sf_response: availability probe fails (timeout or auth error)

assertions: run_soql_query tool call fires with 'SELECT Id FROM User LIMIT 1' as the availability probe and fails
skill does NOT halt — the artifact is still written
output frontmatter contains sf_enriched: false
output frontmatter omits sf_account_id
output does NOT contain an '## Internal Signals (Salesforce)' section
skill emits a one-line warning to the operator containing the substring 'Salesforce MCP unavailable'
no fabricated Activity, Opportunity, Account_Notes__c, or Lifecycle_Stage_History__c content appears in the artifact
output.section_company_facts contains the public-source fact sheet derived from the chosen mode (profiles)
